role: Non-promoting diagnostics; prototype runs are not production qualification
protocol: 200 Hz 1200 s; final 900 s / 180000 samples; original noisy initialization and track unless explicitly ablated
structures_preserved: Each normal replay retains the complete causal filter state, covariance, startup, sensor histories and score window; include overlays make only the recorded changes.
relaxations_introduced: Oracle period/shape, removed sensor error streams and removed cruise acceleration are counterfactual localization controls. Axis prototypes do not qualify freeze/reconfiguration semantics. No theorem inference.
interpretation: Moving default-seed quality gates do not certify other sensor seeds or zero-speed records. Gate exits remain recorded. Exact-band means the exact continuous frozen default-model factor; actual sampled/adaptive-band agreement is approximate.

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
import numpy as np
from scipy.signal import welch
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
R=Path('/workspace/scratch/7542f0d861f1/ocean-imu');O=R.parent/'experiments/round2';sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'tools'))
from carma_fit import carma_psd
from screen import D,N,physics
results=[]
for speed in D:
 for n in N:
  a=np.loadtxt(D[speed]/n,delimiter=',',skiprows=1,usecols=(3,6,9));z=a[60000:,0]
  f,p=welch(z,200,nperseg=32768,noverlap=16384)
  fz=1/physics[n][speed]['heave_tz_s'];x=f/fz
  sel=(x>=.45)&(x<=3.)&(p>p.max()*1e-5)
  xx=x[sel];pp=p[sel];target=10*np.log10(pp)
  weights=np.sqrt(pp/pp.max()) # emphasize wave energy; no RMS metric enters the fit
  def residual(v):
   ps=carma_psd(xx,'41',dict(f1=v[0],z1=v[1],f2=v[2],z2=v[3],fz0=0))
   delta=10*np.log10(ps)-target;delta-=np.average(delta,weights=weights)
   return delta*np.sqrt(weights)
  fits=[least_squares(residual,x0,bounds=([.4,.025,.5,.05],[1.6,.8,8.,2.]),max_nfev=400) for x0 in ([.85,.1,2.5,.5],[.9,.2,1.5,.8],[.8,.05,4.,1.])]
  fit=min(fits,key=lambda x:sum(x.fun*x.fun));row=dict(dataset=speed,input=n,period=1/fz,shape=list(fit.x),cost=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(fit.fun**2))))
  results.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
(O/'shape_fits.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(role='oracle spectral localization; input displacement spectrum only, no RMS tuning',rows=results),indent=2)+'\n')

def gain(sh):
 f1,z1,f2,z2=sh;w1,w2=2*np.pi*np.array([f1,f2]);d=-2*z2*w2
 A=np.zeros((4,4));A[0,1]=A[1,2]=1;A[2]=[d*w1*w1,2*d*z1*w1-w1*w1,d-2*z1*w1,-w2*w2];A[3]=[w1*w1,2*z1*w1,1,0]
 W=np.zeros((4,4));W[2,2]=1;P=solve_continuous_lyapunov(A,-W)
 lo,hi=np.sqrt(P[1,1]/P[0,0])*np.array([.5,4]);J=np.zeros((6,6));J[:4,:4]=A;J[4,2]=lo;J[4,4]=-lo;J[5,2]=hi;J[5,4]=-hi;J[5,5]=-hi;Q=np.zeros((6,6));Q[2,2]=1;B=solve_continuous_lyapunov(J,-Q)
 return float(np.sqrt(P[2,2]/B[5,5]))
